name: Pembroke Backpack
description:
Item Type: Heavy Backpack
Carrying Capacity: 180K µSCU
Core Compatibility: Heavy

Designed to extend the limits of Human endurance, the Pembroke was built to withstand the extreme heat of inhospitable high temperature environments. Based off of Caldera's best-in-class exploration armor platform, an advanced sensor suite intelligently adjusts to environmental conditions so the wearer's body temperature remains stable. A spacious backpack compliments this advanced armor, so those seeking to cross bold new horizons can depend on the Pembroke to see them to the journey's end.
